explanation: The Pakistani pre-emptive strike that widened the war was, the article says, modelled on Israel’s Operation Focus of 1967. The article reads: "The attack was modeled on the Israeli Air Force's Operation Focus during the Six-Day War and intended to neutralize the Indian Air Force planes on the ground."

retraction.reason: A14(4): the quote is about the Pakistani pre-emptive strike of 3 December 1971 — "The attack was modeled on the Israeli Air Force's Operation Focus during the Six-Day War" — which opened the Indo-Pakistani war, not the Bangladesh Liberation War that had been running since March. The 24 September review read it in full and called the endpoint wrong. The atlas holds india-pakistan-war-of-1971, so the reading is kept and moved there; an edge cannot change an end without becoming another record, so this one is withdrawn and six-day-war--india-pakistan-war-of-1971--inspired carries the same quote and the same source.
